notes: Fixed the app forgetting which panels were open and always reopening the Hardware Panel instead. Only the first eight panels in the settings file survived being loaded, and everything past that was discarded without warning. Seven of those…

OG Widget now re-measures and resizes itself when the layout is changed, so dense, relaxed and minimal each fit their content exactly instead of inheriting the previous height. A brief loader covers the change so the panel is not seen…
OG Widget left and right padding doubled.
OG Widget labels now use exactly the same colour as their values and are separated by opacity alone, at 80 percent, so they track the value colour under any theme instead of being a separate shade.
